page_title: Item:Legendary Fragment of a Flayed Mind

enchantments.tooltip: Quality Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Wisdom.
Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one and a half die.
Enhanced Ki +4: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.
Concentration +21: Passive: +21 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
